name: Rika
source:
Favourite manga: Rosario Maiden
Favourite videogame: Super Musashi Galaxy Fight
Favourite food: Takoyaki

Rika is a girl living opposite side of the houses of Taichi and Sakura. She is the founder of the manga club and the best friend of Sakura. She secretly have a little crush on her…

She got very bad experiences with boys and she sees them as perverts since then. Rika cosplays as a hobby and her best and favourite cosplay is the heroine of the Domoco-chan anime. She have strange eyes minnows that makes every boys dreamy. She has a strong kansai accent when she speaks.

[Edited from [url=http://kwk.maxlefou.com]official site[/url]]
